rationale: The application serves as both a high-level administrative dashboard and a high-speed Point of Sale system. We need clean, high-contrast interfaces for data legibility (Dashboard) and large, clear touch targets with clear visual hierarchy for fast operation (POS). Using the existing Light Theme semantic tokens (Corporate Blue + Trust Green) to convey reliability and action.

headings.usage: H1, large metrics, Totals in POS cart

body.usage: Data tables, product names, buttons, small labels

color_palette.accent_success: bg-success (Trust Green - hsl(152 55% 42%)) for the main 'Cobrar' CTA

pos_screen.left_panel: col-span-8 lg:col-span-9, p-4, contains categories and product grid
pos_screen.right_panel: col-span-4 lg:col-span-3, border-l, flex flex-col (cart and totals)

components.cards: Flat, 1px subtle border-border, no heavy shadows by default. Use shadow-sm for interaction.

buttons.hero_cta: Massive, bg-success hover:bg-success/90 text-white font-bold text-xl py-6 (for Cobrar)

components.charts: Recharts AreaChart or LineChart with Corporate Blue (chart-1).

instructions_to_main_agent: Create two mockup components in /app/frontend/src/pages/mockups/: 'DashboardPosMockup.jsx' and 'PosSalesMockup.jsx'.
Do NOT use TypeScript (.tsx), use standard React JSX (.jsx) or (.js).
Add these two new routes to /app/frontend/src/App.js for preview purposes (e.g., /mockup/dashboard and /mockup/pos).
For the POS screen, use a layout that removes the traditional sidebar and takes up the full screen height (h-screen). Build a custom top header and a split view (products left, cart right).
For the Dashboard, assume it's wrapped in the existing DashboardLayout or create a custom standalone view with the required KPIs.
Include a prominent 'MOCKUP / Vista previa de diseño · No funcional' banner at the absolute top of both screens with a warning color.
Use standard Shadcn/UI primitive classes and standard Tailwind utility classes based on the existing index.css variables.
Include the data-testid attribute on all interactive elements as per the critical rules.
